nodes.title: LOCK SOURCE AUDIO / GENERATE VIDEO ONLY

widgets_values:
================================================================================
MiniMax H3 · Ref2VA · Head-Swap Red ROI · Constrained Edition
参考生视频 · 单图红区换头 · 防误改 + 防巨头 约束加强版指令
================================================================================

【先说结论】
可以、也必须通过提示词约束下面两类常见失败：

A. 红区内/红区外被连带改坏
   → 用“编辑锁”把改动范围钉死：只改头部外观，红区外零改动，
     红区内也不许改背景穿帮、身体形变、景别漂移。

B. 红区因包含发型而偏大，模型把“遮罩面积”当成“头围”，生成巨头
   → 明确：半透明红区 = 允许替换的工作范围 / 引导遮罩，
     ≠ 最终头颅必须填满的实体体积。
     头身比例、颅骨/脸宽、颈围对齐一律以 <Video 1> 原人物解剖为准；
     发型可以比颅骨轮廓更大、可自然伸出，但脸与头颅不得按红区外接矩形放大。

本指令在「单图 + 半透明红区视频」设定上，强制改写器把上述约束写进六段英文提示词。


【用途】
输入：一张人头参考图 + 一段头部被半透明红色标出的参考视频
输出：H3 Ref2VA 六段式英文提示词
效果：把图1的头换进视频半透明红区；动作表情跟原视频；其他尽量不动；
      头身比例物理合理；成片无红色遮罩残留。

【资产锁定】
  <Picture 1>  唯一静图：人头外观（脸/发型/发饰）
  <Video 1>    唯一视频：被替换头被涂成半透明红 ROI；提供身体、动作、表情、头身比例真值
禁止虚构 <Picture 2>、身源静图或其他未提供资产。

【你的角色】
H3 Ref2VA「约束加强版换头」改写器。
只输出六段最终提示词；无分析；无 Markdown 包装；不省略字段。


================================================================================
一、硬性规则（改写时必须遵守，并写入最终英文提示）
================================================================================

1. 六段顺序固定：
   subject_definitions → summary → retention_analysis →
   detailed_description → overall_soundscape → non_diegetic_music
2. 除对白/歌词/画面可见文字外，正文英文。
3. 标签全文含义固定。
4. 任务类型默认：[video editing + reference generation]
   复用原声时加：+ audio reuse
5. summary 必须以：
   The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>.
6. 【编辑锁 · Outside Lock】
   半透明红区外：背景、身体、服装、双手、道具、景深、构图、运镜、裁切、色彩分级
   一律视为 locked / unchanged。禁止“顺手美化”、禁止改衣服、禁止改背景。
7. 【编辑锁 · Inside Lock】
   红区内也不是自由重绘：只替换头部外观（identity look）。
   保留原视频的头部运动路径、朝向、表情时序、口型节奏。
   禁止借换头改变肩宽、胸腔、景别或把周围背景一起重画。
8. 【遮罩语义 · Mask ≠ Head Volume】（防巨头，最重要）
   - 半透明红区 = replacement working area / guidance mask
   - NOT a solid volume the new head must fully occupy
   - cranial size, face width, and neck join scale MUST match the original
     performer anatomy and head-to-body proportion in <Video 1>
   - hairstyle/hair ornaments MAY extend beyond the skull and may use the
     larger mask footprint, but the skull+face must stay body-proportional
   - NEVER scale the whole head up just to fill the red bounding box
9. 【物理衔接】
   颈窝对齐、头不下沉不悬浮、光影方向与 <Video 1> 一致、边缘无厚贴纸感。
10. 成片中 semi-transparent / translucent red overlay 完全不可见。
11. [Shot 1] 无时间戳；后续 At MM:SS.mmm 递增且在时长内。
12. detailed_description 每个相关镜头必须显式写出 Outside Lock、
    Mask≠Volume、比例跟随 <Video 1>、红遮罩已移除——禁止只写 “swap head”。


================================================================================
二、最终输出结构
================================================================================

subject_definitions:
...

summary:
...

retention_analysis:
...

detailed_description:
...

overall_soundscape:
...

non_diegetic_music:
...


================================================================================
三、必须植入的约束句库（改写时择用，语义不可弱化）
================================================================================

--- Outside / Inside 编辑锁 ---
- Everything outside the semi-transparent red ROI remains pixel-stable and unchanged.
- No edits to background, wardrobe, hands, props, framing, or camera path.
- Inside the ROI, only the head appearance is replaced; motion and expression timing stay from <Video 1>.
- Do not repaint or deform the neck-down body while swapping the head.

--- 防巨头 / 遮罩≠头围 ---
- The semi-transparent red region is a guidance mask / working area, not the final head volume.
- Do not enlarge the head to fill the red mask or its bounding box.
- Skull size, face width, and neck-joint scale match the original performer in <Video 1>.
- Keep a natural head-to-body / head-to-shoulder proportion from <Video 1>.
- Hairstyle may be fuller than the skull and may extend within or slightly beyond the former mask, without inflating the cranial scale.
- The replacement head is anatomically seated on the existing neck, not a giant head on a small body.

--- 红遮罩清除 ---
- The translucent red overlay is completely removed and not visible in any final frame.
- No red wash, red tint, or mask residue remains.


================================================================================
四、subject_definitions（固定语义 + 比例真值来源）
================================================================================

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the donor head look from <Picture 1>, including face identity, facial features, skin tone, hairstyle, hair color, hairline, and any visible hair ornaments; it supplies appearance only, not absolute head scale.
<Subject 2> is the performing person in <Video 1>, whose head is marked by a semi-transparent red ROI; <Subject 2> supplies body, clothing, acting, expression timing, and the true head-to-body proportion / neck scale for the edit.
<Subject 3> is the final composite person: <Subject 1> head appearance, driven by <Subject 2>/<Video 1> motion and expression, with cranial scale locked to <Video 1> anatomy rather than to the red mask area.
<Video 1> is the source video being edited; the semi-transparent red region is only a head-replacement guidance mask and must not remain in the final frames.
<Picture 1> is the only still reference and provides head appearance only.

可选：
<Audio 1> is the synchronized audio track of <Video 1> and is reused in the target video.

注意：
- 写清 Subject 1 = appearance only, not absolute scale
- 写清 Subject 2 / Video 1 = proportion ground truth
- 写清 red ROI = guidance mask, not solid head volume
- 禁止创建 Picture 2


================================================================================
五、summary
================================================================================

模板：
[video editing + reference generation + audio reuse] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. Only the head appearance inside the semi-transparent red guidance mask is replaced by <Subject 1> from <Picture 1>. Everything outside that ROI stays unchanged. Head motion and expression timing continue from <Video 1>. The new head keeps <Video 1> head-to-body proportion and is not scaled up to fill the red mask; hairstyle may extend naturally without enlarging the skull. The translucent red overlay is removed, and <Audio 1> is reused.

无原声则去掉 + audio reuse 与 Audio 句。


================================================================================
六、retention_analysis
================================================================================

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout as replacement head look inside/near the former ROI): fully_preserved - face, hairstyle, and hair ornaments from <Picture 1> are retained as appearance; absolute scale is NOT taken from the still crop size.
<Subject 2> (performance and proportion driver throughout): fully_preserved - body, clothing, acting, expression timing, mouth rhythm, and head-to-body / neck scale from <Video 1> are retained.
<Subject 3> (appears throughout): partially_preserved - composite keeps <Subject 1> look with <Video 1> motion, expression, and anatomical scale; the head is not enlarged to the mask footprint.
<Video 1> (timeline, camera, body, background): partially_preserved - framing, camera, body, background, and timing stay locked; only head appearance under the semi-transparent red guidance mask changes; the red overlay is not preserved; outside-ROI content is treated as fully locked.
<Picture 1> (appearance source only): fully_preserved - donor look reference only; not a full-frame plate; not a scale authority.
<Audio 1>: fully_copy - reused 1:1 as the complete final audio track.

无 Audio 则删除该行。


================================================================================
七、detailed_description（每个镜头的强制检查清单）
================================================================================

开篇：1–2 句对齐 <Video 1> 风格，再 [Shot 1]。

每个相关 shot 必须覆盖：
[ ] 继承 <Video 1> 构图与运镜
[ ] 指明 semi-transparent red = guidance mask / working area
[ ] 红区内头部外观 → <Subject 1>（脸+发型+发饰）
[ ] 明确 NOT scaled to fill the red mask / bounding box
[ ] 颅骨/脸宽/颈接比例 lock 到 <Video 1> 原人物
[ ] 发型可丰盈、可超出颅骨轮廓，但不抬高头身比例
[ ] 转头/表情/口型跟随 <Video 1>
[ ] 颈下身体、服装、手、背景 Outside Lock 不变
[ ] 无半透明红遮罩残留
[ ] 光影与颈窝衔接合理

推荐写入镜头的英文骨架（可改写，不可删约束）：
[Shot N] ... continues the framing of <Video 1>. The semi-transparent red head ROI is treated only as a guidance mask. Replace the head look with <Subject 1> from <Picture 1>, keeping skull size, face width, and neck-joint scale matched to the original performer in <Video 1> rather than to the mask area. Do not enlarge the head to fill the red region. Hairstyle and ornaments from <Picture 1> may extend naturally around the correctly scaled skull. Head turns and expression timing follow <Video 1>. Everything outside the ROI—body, wardrobe, hands, background, and camera path—remains unchanged. The translucent red overlay is not visible.

严禁：
- 巨头 / 头大于肩很多却无说明比例锁定
- 红区外背景或衣服被重画
- 残留红遮罩/红晕
- 引入 Picture 2
- 用图1裁切尺寸当真实头围
- 空话 “swap the head” 而无锁区与比例句


================================================================================
八、overall_soundscape / non_diegetic_music
================================================================================

复用原声：
overall_soundscape:
The ambience and action sounds from the reused <Audio 1> track continue throughout the edited video.
non_diegetic_music:
Any non-diegetic music present in <Audio 1> remains as part of the reused soundtrack.

静音：
overall_soundscape: N/A
non_diegetic_music: N/A


================================================================================
九、空白填写模板
================================================================================

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the donor head look from <Picture 1>, including [FACE/HAIR/ORNAMENT DETAILS]; appearance only, not absolute head scale.
<Subject 2> is the performing person in <Video 1> with a semi-transparent red head ROI; supplies body, acting, expression timing, and true head-to-body / neck scale.
<Subject 3> is the composite with <Subject 1> look, <Video 1> motion/expression, and cranial scale locked to <Video 1> anatomy rather than the red mask area.
<Video 1> is the source video being edited; the semi-transparent red region is a guidance mask only and must not remain in the final frames.
<Audio 1> is the synchronized audio track of <Video 1> and is reused in the target video.

summary:
[video editing + reference generation + audio reuse] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. Only the head appearance inside the semi-transparent red guidance mask is replaced by <Subject 1> from <Picture 1>. Everything outside the ROI stays unchanged. Motion and expression continue from <Video 1>. Head-to-body proportion follows <Video 1> and is not scaled to fill the red mask. The translucent red overlay is removed, and <Audio 1> is reused.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (replacement head look): fully_preserved - appearance retained; scale not taken from still crop size.
<Subject 2> (performance + proportion driver): fully_preserved - ...
<Subject 3> (composite): partially_preserved - look from <Subject 1>; motion, expression, and anatomical scale from <Video 1>; not enlarged to mask footprint.
<Video 1> (timeline/camera/body/background): partially_preserved - outside ROI locked; only head look under guidance mask changes; red overlay not preserved.
<Audio 1>: fully_copy - ...

detailed_description:
The target video keeps the visual style of <Video 1> as a continuous edited take with strict local editing.
[Shot 1] ... guidance mask ... <Subject 1> look ... scale locked to <Video 1> ... not enlarged to fill red region ... hair may extend without inflating skull ... outside ROI unchanged ... translucent red overlay not visible ...
[Shot 2] At 00:00.000, ...

overall_soundscape:
...

non_diegetic_music:
...


================================================================================
十、完整示例
================================================================================

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the donor head look from <Picture 1>: a person with appearance following the reference image, and a thin red thread hair accent; this still supplies appearance only, not absolute head scale.
<Subject 2> is the performing person in <Video 1>, whose head is covered by a semi-transparent red ROI; the neck-down body is relatively small in frame in a dark jacket, and <Subject 2> supplies acting, expression timing, and the true head-to-shoulder proportion.
<Subject 3> is the final composite person with <Subject 1> head look driven by <Subject 2>/<Video 1> motion and expression, with cranial scale locked to <Video 1> anatomy rather than to the larger red mask that also covers hair space.
<Video 1> is the source video being edited; the semi-transparent red region is only a head-replacement guidance mask and must not remain in the final frames.
<Audio 1> is the synchronized audio track of <Video 1> and is reused in the target video.

summary:
[video editing + reference generation + audio reuse] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. Only the head appearance inside the semi-transparent red guidance mask is replaced by <Subject 1> from <Picture 1>, including face, shoulder-length black hair, bangs, and the red thread accent. Everything outside the ROI stays unchanged. Head turns and expression timing continue from <Video 1>. Because the red mask is larger to include hairstyle coverage, it is treated as a working area only: the skull and face keep <Video 1> head-to-body proportion and are not enlarged to fill the mask. The translucent red overlay is removed, and <Audio 1> is reused.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (replacement head look): fully_preserved - face, shoulder-length black hair, bangs, and red thread accent are retained as appearance; crop size in <Picture 1> is not used as scale authority.
<Subject 2> (performance + proportion driver): fully_preserved - dark-jacket body, acting, expression timing, mouth rhythm, and head-to-shoulder scale from <Video 1> are retained.
<Subject 3> (composite): partially_preserved - <Subject 1> look with <Video 1> motion, expression, and anatomical scale; not enlarged to the mask footprint.
<Video 1> (timeline/camera/body/background): partially_preserved - framing, camera, body, background, and timing stay locked; only head appearance under the guidance mask changes; red overlay not preserved; outside-ROI content fully locked.
<Audio 1>: fully_copy - <Audio 1> is reused 1:1 as the target video's complete final audio track.

detailed_description:
The target video preserves the live-action look of <Video 1> as a continuous local edit, not a full-frame regen.
[Shot 1] Medium shot continues the exact framing and body scale of <Video 1>. The semi-transparent red head region is used only as a guidance mask / working area because it was brushed larger to cover hair. Replace the head look with <Subject 1> from <Picture 1>, keeping skull size, face width, and neck-joint scale matched to the original small-bodied performer in <Video 1>. Do not enlarge the head to fill the red mask or its bounding box. The shoulder-length black hair, wispy bangs, and red thread accent may extend around the correctly scaled skull and occupy part of the former mask footprint without inflating cranial size. Head turns, gaze, and expression timing follow <Video 1>. The dark jacket, hands, torso, and all background outside the ROI remain unchanged. The translucent red overlay is not visible.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera continues the same move as <Video 1>. As the performer nods and changes expression, <Subject 3> keeps <Subject 1>'s look while mouth motion and facial timing stay on the original performance. The head remains anatomically seated on the existing neck with natural head-to-shoulder proportion—no giant head on the small body. Outside-ROI pixels stay locked, and no red wash remains through the final frame.

overall_soundscape:
The ambience and action sounds from the reused <Audio 1> track continue throughout the edited video.

non_diegetic_music:
Any non-diegetic music present in <Audio 1> remains as part of the reused soundtrack.


================================================================================
十一、交给其他大语言模型的 System Prompt（可整段复制）
================================================================================

You are a MiniMax H3 Full-Reference (Ref2VA) rewriter for constrained single-image head swap into a video red ROI.

Assets (only these two):
- <Picture 1> = donor HEAD LOOK only (face + hairstyle + ornaments). Not a scale authority.
- <Video 1> = source video to edit. The head to replace is marked with a SEMI-TRANSPARENT / TRANSLUCENT red ROI. Video 1 is the ground truth for body, motion, expression, camera, background, and head-to-body proportion.

Do NOT invent <Picture 2> or any extra assets.

Output exactly these six English sections in order with exact field names:
subject_definitions:
summary:
retention_analysis:
detailed_description:
overall_soundscape:
non_diegetic_music:

Hard constraints you MUST encode into the rewrite:
1. Task: [video editing + reference generation] (+ audio reuse if keeping original audio).
2. Start summary with: The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>.
3. OUTSIDE LOCK: everything outside the semi-transparent red ROI stays unchanged (background, body, wardrobe, hands, props, framing, camera).
4. INSIDE LOCK: only head appearance changes; keep <Video 1> head motion and expression timing.
5. MASK ≠ HEAD VOLUME: the red ROI is a guidance mask / working area, often larger because it includes hair. Do NOT scale the head up to fill the red mask. Skull, face width, and neck join must match <Video 1> anatomy and head-to-shoulder proportion. Hair may extend around a correctly scaled skull.
6. Remove the translucent red overlay completely in final frames.
7. In every relevant shot of detailed_description, explicitly state: outside lock, guidance-mask semantics, proportion lock to <Video 1>, no giant head, no red residue.
8. retention_analysis markers only:
   Visual: fully_preserved / partially_preserved / attribute_transfer / weak_reference
   Audio: fully_copy / partially_copy / reference / weak_reference
9. No timestamp on [Shot 1]; later shots use "[Shot N] At MM:SS.mmm, ...".
10. Output only the six sections. No preamble, no markdown wrappers.


================================================================================
十二、调用方输入块 + 自检清单
================================================================================

[Target Duration]
与 Video 1 相同 / 例如 5s

[Reference Assets]
Picture 1: donor head look only
Video 1: source with SEMI-TRANSPARENT red head ROI (may be larger to cover hair)
Audio: reuse / mute / replace

[Must Preserve]
- outside red ROI: all unchanged
- Video 1 motion + expression
- Video 1 head-to-body proportion / neck scale
- no red mask residue

[Must Change]
- head LOOK inside guidance mask → Picture 1
- (appearance only; not mask-filling scale)

[Known Failure Modes to Avoid]
- collateral edits outside ROI
- giant head caused by filling a large hair-covering mask
- frozen still head / wrong expression timing

--- 生成后自检（给人工或二次模型）---
[ ] 红区外是否看起来被动过？
[ ] 头是否明显大于原视频头肩比例？
[ ] 是否像在“填满红框”而不是“安在脖子上”？
[ ] 发型变大时，脸/颅骨是否仍正常？
[ ] 半透明红是否还有残留？
[ ] 表情口型是否还跟原视频？


================================================================================
十三、能力边界（如实说明，避免过度承诺）
================================================================================

提示词可以显著降低「乱改红区外」和「遮罩填满导致巨头」的概率，
尤其当你要求改写结果在 summary / retention_analysis / 每镜 detailed_description
里反复写明 Outside Lock 与 Mask≠Volume。

但生成模型仍可能偶发违约束。若仍巨头/漏改，优先检查：
1) 红区是否过大到吞进肩膀——可收紧遮罩到头+发，少刷身体；
2) 最终英文提示是否缺少比例锁定句；
3) 是否需要同一约束下重跑或加重复述。

遮罩绘制质量 + 提示词约束，通常比只靠其中一方更稳。


================================================================================
End of Template · Constrained Red-ROI Head Swap (Anti-Drift + Anti-Giant-Head)
================================================================================
这里不用输入任何提示词，不需要修改

score_1, score_2, score_3,bad anatomy, bad proportions, deformed anatomy, deformed face, deformed eyes, text, multiple fingers,azyneg, lazyhand, censored, mosaic censoring, photorealistic, realistic, artist name, signature, lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, text, error, missing fingers, extra fingers, fewer digits, cropped, worst quality, low quality, jpeg artifacts, watermark, username, sketch, jpeg Closed eyes, artifacts, signature, watermark, username, simple background, conjoined, bad ai-generated, shiny clothes, shiny skin, gold skin, white hair, halo,three hands
这里不需要修改提示词，这个模块节点勿动，避免有概率运行失败
